muse-spark-1.3-contributor.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor
muse-spark-1.3-contributor.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta for long-running agentic, multi-agent, and coding workflows. It improves long-horizon agent collaboration, instruction following, and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.

muse-spark-1.1.name: Muse Spark 1.1
muse-spark-1.1.description: Muse Spark is a natively multimodal reasoning model with support for tool-use, visual chain of thought, and multi-agent orchestration.

muse-spark-1.2.name: Muse Spark 1.2
muse-spark-1.2.description: Muse Spark 1.2 is a coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1 with improvements in code generation, complex debugging, codebase understanding, and end-to-end developer workflows.

muse-spark-1.3.name: Muse Spark 1.3
muse-spark-1.3.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta for long-running agentic, multi-agent, and coding workflows. It improves long-horizon agent collaboration, instruction following, and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.

muse-wonder-1.0.name: Muse Wonder
muse-wonder-1.0.description: Muse Wonder is a frontier multimodal reasoning model from Meta for personal and professional agents, long-horizon coding, and computer use. It combines Active Memory, which carries relevant context across conversations, with Active Focus, which keeps it working through blockers toward a goal.
